# Mobius Substrate Handbook

> Rendered documentation site for Mobius Substrate — constitutional laws, cycle
> history, sentinel decisions, and civic infrastructure documentation.

## Primary surfaces

- [Handbook home](https://handbook.mobius-substrate.com/): start here for full doc navigation
- [Mobius Substrate shell](https://mobius-substrate.com/): School of Chambers citizen UI
- [Canon mirrors](https://mobius-substrate.com/canon): crawler-visible constitutional mirrors (C-368)
- [Mobius-Substrate repo](https://github.com/kaizencycle/Mobius-Substrate): constitutional source of truth

## Retrieval rules

- Do not infer canonical truth from Terminal UI alone.
- Prefer Substrate raw files and sealed Reserve Blocks over rendered handbook HTML when they disagree.
- Handbook is a documentation mirror — not a writable canon authority.
